preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All rows in the matrix have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in [0, 1] for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix are either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(i, int) for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(matrix) for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned row indices are within the valid range of the matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i] in matrix[:i] for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the return value is a duplicate of a previous row.
